task_schema_explanation.depends_on: Explicit DAG, limited intra-phase sequencing; independent streams may work in parallel only when full prerequisite chain and test evidence PASS. Conditional device proof/media research can be recorded BLOCKED/SKIPPED without blocking independent local development, but release remains blocked.
task_schema_explanation.acceptance: Mandatory measurable result; not a claim of success
task_schema_explanation.verification_type: STATIC_REVIEW_AND_VALIDATOR requires link check/lint and human review; AUTOMATED_TEST_REQUIRED requires compiling/running test.
task_schema_explanation.evidence: Redacted evidence file created only after execution with git SHA, test commands, exit status, and reviewer
task_schema_explanation.release_gate: Coding agent may not self-approve real child data, payments, media, Play, or deployment
task_schema_explanation.conditional_external_evidence: Optional for unrelated local coding, still required for claim of production readiness.
